name: moh731V2023HivTestsPatientListTemplate
description: Patient list template for MOH 731 (Ver. July 2023) 1.1 HIV Tests. The base dataset already carries every linelist column, so this only satisfies the generator's join. It has no group by, so the linelist stays one row per test -- the same rows its figure counts -- rather than collapsing clients tested more than once.
